title: Squalane for Hair: What It Is and What the Research Shows
seo_title: Squalane for Hair & Scalp: What It Is & What Studies Show | FullyVital
seo_description: What squalane is, what research shows about it as an emollient and carrier in skin, and why there is no evidence that it grows hair.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Old post (1,808 words, 0 study links) claimed hair benefits. Removed; rewritten as an explainer of what squalane is and does, with an honest 'no hair-growth evidence'.
flags: The closing FullyVital product box (unchanged, sitewide) says products 'Promote Hair Regrowth'. Left for you, as with boron.
No hair-growth study exists for squalane. Evidence is too thin for a standard refresh; you may prefer to hold or merge it.
The Dupres 2007 study used squalane only as a test liquid. The article says so, to avoid implying it supports hair benefits.
